changes: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts now treats story_create --fromDraft as a bounded metadata transaction: it preflights staged index changes before mutation, stages only active-story/source-draft paths, verifies only those bounded paths after commit, and merges main into the new story branch. packages/main/src/tasks/worktree-authority-smoke.ts now covers clean fromDraft, committed draft deletion, unrelated unstaged/untracked dirty preservation, staged-index rejection before mutation, bounded metadata cleanliness, and story branch ancestry.
usage: Use koala story_create {"fromDraft":"<draft-name>"} from main after an approved draft. If the git index has staged unrelated changes, Koala rejects before mutation. If main only has unstaged or untracked unrelated edits, Koala creates the story worktree, commits the bounded story/draft metadata, merges main into story/B-*, and prints the cd guidance.
expectedOutcome: The user sees Story B-xxxx created from draft, a concrete .worktrees/B-xxxx path, cd guidance, clean bounded story/draft metadata on main, preserved unrelated unstaged/untracked changes, pre-mutation rejection for unrelated staged changes, and story/B-* containing current main.
actualTranscript: Real temp-repo transcript: clean/dirty-unrelated case printed Story B-c265 created from draft, worktree path, cd guidance, main merged into story/B-c265, boundedStatus="", mainStatus="M tracked.txt\n?? untracked.txt", mainAncestorOfStory=yes. Staged case printed requires a clean git index before mutating story/draft/worktree metadata, activeStories=[], draftStillExists=true, worktreeStoryBranch=absent, stagedStatus="M\tstaged.txt".
outcomeDiff: No product diff: actual transcript matches expected success path and staged rejection path.
limitations: none — fully covered by targeted smoke, koala validate, reviewer passes, and delivery transcript.
pitfalls: The first fix preserved unstaged/untracked dirty main changes but still checked the staged index after story_create/dev_start, so staged unrelated changes could fail after partial mutation. The final fix moves staged-index preflight before mutation and keeps the later bounded staging guard as defense in depth.
